Warmed-over flavor.question: The _____ was Unpleasant odor caused by meat decomposition after cooking.
Warmed-over flavor.fact: Warmed-over flavor is an unpleasant characteristic usually associated with meat which has been cooked and then refrigerated. Warmed-over flavor is caused by the oxidative decomposition of lipids (fatty substances) in the meat into chemicals (short-chain aldehydes or ketones) which have an unpleasant taste or odor.
